title: TestOutput
description: Output produced by Agent C (Tester & Debugger) after generating and running a pytest suite against Agent B's implementation output.

tested_file.description: Filename of the Agent B module under test (e.g. product_manager.py)

language.description: Programming language of the code under test

test_code.description: The generated pytest module as a string

test_file.description: Path where the generated test file was written

syntax_check.description: ast.parse result for the generated test code ('passed' or an error message)

mode.description: How tests were generated: qwen_api or mock_generator_fallback

retry_used.description: Whether a retry or fallback was triggered during generation

retry_reason.description: Reason a retry/fallback was used, or 'none'

summary.description: Pass/fail counts from the sandbox run
